items.description: CanyonRunner is a 2D side-scroller HTML5 game that works on desktop and mobile, features a story and all the basic game systems you'd expect such as a progress saving system, top scores, different game dynamics on each level and two different endings. This application uses Ludei Cloud API.
twitQA is a place where you can see followers interacting with each other in a most knowledgeable way. Everything is asked, answered and discussed by people like you.
Dial a phone number and log the call in the Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2011 system using ClicktoDial.
A rendering of the public Twitter timeline. The app was built using Sharendipity, so you can take this and modify it.
Find quotes from people about arbitrary topics.
Find the altitude of any place with a point-and-click interface.
Makes it easy to review and delete/keep your old delicious bookmarks by showing the web page in a n iframe right next to some delete/keep buttons
DD Smart is an initiative taken by Dunkin Donuts to provide customers with health and fitness data.

Rentenna leveraged the BlockAvenue API to pull down local Block Reviews about nearby streets and neighborhoods and mashed it up on their property detail pages to help people who are looking to rent an apartment

A submission to the Australian Government's Mashup Australia incentive. This mashup uses Victorian schools, emergency services, and 2006 Australian Census data to visualise what a school and its area might be like.
Slick custom interface on Virtual Earth map to search for real estate in Australia with user-defined property criteria and location.
Like tinyurl, but for maps. Create a map, add routes or points of interest, and get a short URL to share it or come back to it later.
Leverages a database of 117,000 cell phone tower locations and Google Maps to help you see where coverage is and isn't.

An Amazon Product API mashup that aggregates products across 80 categories. Every day the product selections are updated to include Amazon's top sellers, most gifted, most wished-for and new releases from each respective category.
Features information on the Southern Highlands of NSW, Australia. Google Map mashups are included with each town profile, and business listed on the site.

Time tracking, inventory and resource management from your phone. Time Keeper and Inventory Tracker updates by SMS or web. Barcode generator; scan and text to update. Project Management integration. SMS requires a Twilio account.
A novel system that can automatically read reviews and generate an accurate summary.

Music2Mail.com is a music notification service. You can subscribe to a list of your favorite artists and receive an email whenever one of these artists has a new release. Search artists or import from Last.fm.
Snaggle aggregates Craigslist for sale items for selected cities and places them on a map. It allows users to filter items by category and to search by location.
Doculib.org is a free pdf file sharing site using Bing Search Api.
Photoree aims to be to photos what Last.fm is to music and StumbleUpon to websites. It adapts to your preferences and taste, recommending to you the best images that may interest you.
